x: Strange, 480yds ; 2, F H Elson, 205yds ; 3, H J Fletcher, 540yds Time 14m. 12s. Mitcham A.C. had a glorious evening on June 4th for their Charity Sports at the " News of the World " ground, in which was included the second series of the inter-club relays
Peacock won the walk easily, but H J Fletcher kept his lead until the last lap. The scratch man, A.
Elson won off a long mark in style which showed that in a few years he may emulate his brother, who finished second. The same remark applies to H.

They will see one of the finest walkers in the country—both for performance and action—on the scratch mark; but what is more remarkable, they will see the young front-markers walking in faultless fashion and without any of the movements that rightly make the crowd laugh. Of the younger walkers, the best are H.

When one remembers last year's time, namely, 31 min. 27 sec., and then realizes that the first eight this year were inside that, it will be granted that we are justified in our high hopes for he race on April 12th. The handicap held in ocnjunction with the run resulted in a win for H.

So far as watching the race was concerned it was hopeless as the runners disappeared from sight and unless one was prepared to trudge a mile and a half up the Long Walk one did not see them again until the finish. Even at the half-distance our boys were hopelessly placed and it speaks well for Frank Webb and H.
These two gained first-class standard medals (inside 16sec.) and the following received second-class standards, (inside 16min. 30sec.): H.
Dewberry 3, Arthur Allum 4, Bill Webb 6, and H.
